name: Tufte Ink
description: Porcelain white with ink-black serif and a whisper of academic ink-blue. Edward Tufte data-ink minimalism — wide margins, a faint sidenote column grid, tabular figures, almost-no-accent. For paper interpretation and rigorous academic talks.
descriptionZh: Tufte 数据墨水学术风. 瓷白纸 + 墨黑 serif (Source Serif) + 几乎无 accent (仅一抹学术墙墨蓝). 签名: 超宽留白 + 侧注栏网格 + tabular figures. 像 Edward Tufte / 学术 slide 的极简, 最适合论文解读.
bestFor: 论文解读 / paper 解读
